_doc: The night-time underworld on the street map (systems/nightStreets.js; the street map's half ui/innerMapNight.js; the scenes ui/actionMenu/nightScenes.js). DARK: darkness cuts how far folk see a deed on the street (StreetCrime.selectWitnesses, a container theft): up to dark.maxSightCut tiles at full dark, scaled by the light's darkness; a light carried (a lantern or torch: L on the street map shutters or lights it) cuts nothing and the watch sees you from litSpotRadius. CURFEW: a realm's curfew law (data/laws.json laws.curfew) or a town's own ordinance (settlement.ordinances.curfew, else a hash of the town: local.townShare) shuts the streets from the curfew bell (hours.from) to dawn (hours.to): townsfolk go home and stay in, more of the watch turns out (extraWatchShare of the day watch) and walks its beat with lanterns, and a guard who sees you out stops you: talk your way home, bribe, run, or take the fine (submit). Every coin is real: a fine to the town's purse (the realm's punishment law scales it), a bribe into the guard's purse. LANDINGS: on some nights (chance, a hash of the town and the night) one of the town's gangs lands contraband at a quiet shore or river bank: goods it bought over the border (Gangs._source: out of that town's market, its purse paid). Join: carry the load for a cut of it (cutShare, untaxed contraband in your pack: the black market or the legal market's tariff), at the risk of a raid. Inform the watch: the load is seized and goes onto the town's market, a reward from the town's purse, the gang's grudge. Rob them: take it all (hot goods) or take a beating. NIGHT MARKET: in a back alley, after dark (hours), the gangs sell their stash cheaply (stashPrice x the black-market price; fenced goods still cooling at fencedPrice of their worth, hot to you) and their fence buys yours. Only a guild contact, a guild hand or a gang's own gets in; a grudge (informing, robbing a landing) keeps you out for grudgeDays.

halt: You there! The bell's long rung!
after_let_go: Off home. I'll not tell you twice.
market: Nothing here you'd want the watch to see.

text.curfew_text: {guard} of the watch holds up a lantern to your face. "The curfew bell rang at {from}. What business have you on the street at this hour?"
text.talk_ok: You talk your way out of it. {guard} waves you on: "Indoors, and quick about it."
text.talk_fail: {guard} isn't having it. Fined {fine}g for breaking the curfew.
text.bribe_ok: {guard} weighs the coin, pockets it and looks the other way.
text.bribe_fail: {guard} knocks the coin from your hand. "Trying to buy the watch?" Fined {fine}g.
text.flee_ok: You bolt down an alley and lose them in the dark. The watch will remember your face.
text.flee_fail: You don't get far. They drag you off to the cells.
text.submit: You take the fine: {fine}g, paid to the town.
text.broke: You can't pay the fine. They take you to the cells for the night.
text.landing_text: A boat lies drawn up on the {shore}, a shuttered lantern in the bow. {crew} figures are hauling crates ashore: {units} {good}, landed from {from} by {gang}.
text.landing_text_land: Packhorses stand on the {shore}, a shuttered lantern hung low. {crew} figures are unloading: {units} {good}, run in from {from} by {gang}.
text.join_ok: You carry crates through the dark until the boat is empty. Your cut: {cut} {good}, nobody's tariff paid on it.
text.join_raided: Lanterns on the bank: the watch! The goods are seized.
text.inform_ok: You slip off to the watch house. Within the hour lanterns close on the {shore}: the load is seized and you are paid {reward}g from the town's purse. {gang} will not forget it.
text.rob_ok: You fall on them out of the dark. They scatter, and the whole load is yours: {units} {good}, hot as coals.
text.rob_fail: They were ready for you. A beating, {lost}g gone from your purse, and you're left in the shallows.
text.market_text: Behind {where}, a lantern hangs over a cellar door. {fence} sits among crates of things nobody bought honestly.
text.market_shut: The cellar door is barred. The night market opens after dark.
text.market_refused: The lookout steps into your path. "Not you. Not after what you did."
text.market_stranger: The lookout steps into your path. "Don't know you. Find someone who does." (A guild contact in the tavern opens the way.)
